title.en: Getting started with the MoonBit backend stack
title.zh:
MoonBit 后端与微服务
快速入门

standfirst.en: Every chapter adds one capability to the same running service. By the last one it answers over HTTP, GraphQL and gRPC, keeps its rows in SQLite, and carries tests that fail when any of that stops being true.
standfirst.zh: 每章只给同一个服务添一样能力。到最后一章，它同时用 HTTP、GraphQL 和 gRPC 对外服务，数据落在 SQLite 里，还带着一套测试：哪一样坏了，测试就会失败。

note.en: `x-request-id` is the chapter-01 middleware. `server: mooncat` is the transport signing its own work. The body is a row moonsqlite returned and moonorm decoded, on the connection the process opened at boot. [Start with chapter 01](ch01-service.html) to watch each of them land.
note.zh: `x-request-id` 由中间件加上；`server: mooncat` 是传输层写下的名字。正文是 moonsqlite 返回、moonorm 解码出的一行，走的是进程启动时打开的那条连接。详见[从第 1 章开始](ch01-service.html)。

layersHint.en: in the order the request meets them

layersLead.en: Each line is one library doing one thing to the same request, and any of them can be swapped without the others noticing. The numbers match the transcript in chapter 8.
layersLead.zh: 每行只做一件事；换掉任何一个库，其余都不用改。编号与第 8 章的回放对得上。

did.en: Reads the `.api` spec into routes and types.
did.zh: 把 `.api` 描述读成路由与类型。

did.en: Carries the request value that every layer shares.
did.zh: 在各层之间传递同一个请求值。

did.en: Wraps the routes in a service and logs the call.
did.zh: 把路由装进服务，并记下这次调用。

did.en: Matches the path, binds `id`, builds the body.
did.zh: 匹配路径、绑定 `id`、拼出响应体。

did.en: Builds the statement, then decodes the row it gets back.
did.zh: 拼出 SQL，再把查回的行解码成记录。

did.en: Writes the bytes to the socket.
did.zh: 把字节写到 socket 上。

did.en: Answers the same data as a GraphQL field on the same app.
did.zh: 同一个应用上，用 GraphQL 字段回答同一份数据。

did.en: Serves the same greeting over HTTP/2 cleartext.
did.zh: 同一句问候，再走一遍 h2c。

did.en: Asks a model, through a template and a provider.
did.zh: 用模板和提供者调用模型。

colophon.en: every output on these pages comes from a real run
colophon.zh: 本站每个输出都来自真实运行

hint.en: the toolchain, the code, one run

lead.en: The service is a native program: it listens on a port and links SQLite. You need the MoonBit toolchain and a C compiler — gcc or clang, or Visual Studio's on Windows.
lead.zh: 这个服务是原生程序：它监听端口，并链接 SQLite。要装好 MoonBit 工具链和一个 C 编译器：gcc 或 clang，Windows 上用 Visual Studio 自带的。

variants.code:
# the toolchain: Linux and macOS, then Windows in PowerShell
$ curl -fsSL https://cli.moonbitlang.com/install/unix.sh | bash
> irm https://cli.moonbitlang.com/install/powershell.ps1 | iex

# the code, its tests, and the service on port 12000
$ git clone https://github.com/moonbitstack/moonhelo
$ cd moonhelo
$ moon test --target native
$ moon run src/cmd/greet-server --target native

# from a second terminal
$ curl -s localhost:12000/ping
pong

next.en: Chapter 01 starts from this running service and takes it apart.
next.zh: 第 01 章就从这个跑起来的服务讲起，一层一层拆开看。

hint.zh: 选一次，各章都照此显示

lead.en: Where a library offers more than one shape for the same thing, the sample shows each, with tabs above it. All three stay, because each suits a different size of service.
lead.zh: 同一件事库里有几种写法时，示例把每种都列出来，用上方的页签切换。三种写法都保留，是因为它们各适合不同规模的服务。

did.en: Routes are calls on an app value, each handler next to its path. Start here: nothing to learn before the first route.
did.zh: 路由就是在应用值上的调用，处理函数紧挨着它的路径。从这里起步，写第一条路由前不用先学别的。

did.en: A route is a value that answers its path, so it can hold a connection or a cache for as long as it lives.
did.zh: 路由是一个能应答路径的值，所以它能在存活期间一直持有连接或缓存。

did.en: `#app.get` and `#orm.table` on plain functions and structs; the generator writes the registration and the model, which keeps forty routes readable.
did.zh: 在普通函数和结构体上写 `#app.get`、`#orm.table`，注册代码和模型由生成器写出，路由到了四十条也照样好读。

did.en: Not a tab but a road through the whole course: one `.api` file, from which moonctl generates the routes, the types and the model. Chapter 02.
did.zh: 不是页签，而是贯穿全书的一条路：一份 `.api` 文件，moonctl 据此生成路由、类型和模型。见第 02 章。
